faq.q: What is the origin of Afshin?
faq.a: Afshin is associated with Persian. Afshīn was the title of the rulers of Ushrusana in Transoxiana; the name is traced to Avestan Pisinah and is linked to Old Iranian xšāyati ('king, ruler'). The source record's gloss 'Fair, Just, Peaceful' is unsupported.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.

faq.q: What does Afshin mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Afshin is rendered افشین and carries the sense حکمران، بادشاہ، سردار.

faq.q: What does Afshin mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Afshin is rendered افشین and carries the sense فرمانروا، شاه، سردار.
A romanized syllable approximation is af-shin. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Afshin?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Afshin, afshin. Script forms are افشین, अफ़शीन.

faq.q: Is Afshin a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
